# HR Leave and Benefits Policy

## Section 1: Annual Leave Entitlement

1.1 Full-time employees are entitled to 20 days of paid annual leave per calendar year, except for employees in their initial 90-day probationary period.

1.2 Accrued annual leave may be carried over up to 5 days into the following calendar year, unless the employee is on a fixed-term seasonal contract.

## Section 2: Bereavement and Sabbatical Leave

2.1 Employees with five years of continuous tenure may apply for a paid sabbatical of four weeks, subject to Section 4 approval and staffing requirements.

2.2 Part-time contractors working fewer than 15 hours per week are not entitled to paid sabbatical leave or holiday stipends.

## Section 3: Remote Work Stipend

3.1 Eligible staff receive a $500 home-office equipment stipend annually, provided that all receipts are submitted within 30 days of purchase and subject to §1.1 eligibility.

## Section 4: Sabbatical Approval Conditions

4.1 Sabbatical applications must be submitted 60 days in advance and approved by both the department head and People Operations, except in documented medical emergencies.
